about_blocks.text: The length of stay at Foundation House is flexible and based upon the individual’s needs; they generally range from 3 months to 1 year. If needed a resident is welcome to stay for two years. Once residents are stabilized and thinking clearly and able to establish a practical educational or career plan, they can, if they desire, transfer to the second stage house. It is our hope that, upon leaving the VIARS houses, residents will have established themselves in an alcohol and drug free lifestyle and be prepared to continue in a productive life-style. Ideally this would include continuing involvement in a 12 Step Program, a solid support network of non-using friends, productive leisure activities, effective stress coping skills, a strong sense of personal responsibility for their recovery process and long term education and career goals.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
